rationale: Failures occurred specifically on repeat 0, suggesting the agent sometimes skips the property on its first attempt. A dedicated checklist step creates a second-pass verification gate separate from the initial schema construction, catching omissions before the verifier does.
expected_effect: Agent performs an explicit audit step that catches and fixes missing additionalProperties:false fields prior to completion, eliminating the undefined-value failures seen across all three tasks.
regression_risk: Low. The additive checklist step runs after normal implementation; it does not change how tools are defined or how arguments are validated, so existing passing behaviors are preserved.
